brief: The canvas displays a vast, dynamic field of mineral slurry and biological matter, exhibiting constant, flowing movement. Mottled zones of varying density and vivid, diffuse colors shift and expand across the surface, constantly mimicking the slow, creeping life of a slime mould. The slurry appears to diffuse energy from unknown sources, creating rippling, shifting patterns of light and shadow. By dragging the cursor across the canvas, the viewer can perturb this flow, initiating new plumes of energy or momentarily concentrating the slurry into a visible, energetic burst.

statement: This sketch creates a dynamic, flowing field of mineral slurry and biological matter that simulates the slow, creeping movement of slime mould. Using a particle system with a noise-based flow field, it generates organic, ever-shifting patterns across the canvas. The particles are influenced by both a continuous background flow and user interaction through dragging, creating ripples and bursts of energy as the viewer perturbs the system. The visual effect combines subtle color variations, smooth motion, and a glowing ambient light to evoke a sense of deep, mysterious biological processes at work.
